mapper.update: UPDATE incident_ticket_link SET status='ESTABLISHED',ticket_id=#{ticketId},established_at=#{establishedAt}, recovery_required_at=NULL,recovery_reason_code=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND incident_id=#{incidentId} AND status IN('REQUESTED','RECOVERY_REQUIRED') AND lock_version=#{lockVersion}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED',resolved_at=#{now},next_attempt_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND state IN('OPEN','REPLAYING') AND source_record_id IN(SELECT outbox_id FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND aggregate_type='INCIDENT' AND aggregate_id=#{incidentId} AND contract_ref=#{contractRef} AND contract_version=1)

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED',resolved_at=#{now},next_attempt_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND direction='INBOX' AND source_record_id=#{inbox} AND state IN('OPEN','REPLAYING')
mapper.select: SELECT inbox_id,business_intent_key,body_bytes,body_sha256,status,result_id,lock_version FROM inbox_message WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND producer_service=#{producer} AND message_id=#{message} FOR UPDATE

SELECT inbox_id,business_intent_key,body_bytes,body_sha256,status,result_id,lock_version FROM inbox_message WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND producer_service=#{producer} AND contract_ref=#{contract} AND business_intent_key=#{intent} FOR UPDATE
